info.title: API.SH: Zumper
info.description: The Zumper API from API.SH: public Zumper data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A property management company or brokerage on Zumper: name, company, brokerage id, logo, phone, website, description, account date, application and screening fees, region, and (with `location`) its current listings in that place with the search filters and paging. Private landlords are not returned (404).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zumper-agent

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Manager id (manager.id of a search result).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Optional: also list this manager's listings in this place (as in /zumper/v1/search).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Listings per page (max 50).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Result page (1 = first).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Zumper's suggestions for what was typed: cities, neighborhoods, ZIP codes, schools, universities and buildings, each with its type, id, slug (ready for the search, neighborhoods and rent-report endpoints), city, state, coordinates, bounding box and search link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zumper-autocomplete

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A place, ZIP code, school or building name.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Rank suggestions near this latitude (with lng).

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Rank suggestions near this longitude (with lat).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One rental listing or apartment building on Zumper: title, description, status, property and lease type, lease terms, rent and rent range, price history, recent rentals at the same address with their prices (rent history), bedrooms, bathrooms, size, availability, listed date, year built, full address with coordinates and neighborhood, amenities and building amenities, pet policy, fees and deposits, parking, specials, office hours, photos, floor plans (buildings) and the managing company or brokerage with its phone and website (private landlords' names and phones are left out). Give `id` (listing), `building_id`, a zumper.com link as `url`, or `latest=true` with the search params to open the first current result.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zumper-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Zumper listing id (id of a search result).

parameters.name: building_id
parameters.description: Zumper building id (building_id of a search result).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A zumper.com /listings/ or /apartment-buildings/ link.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: run the search with the other params and open its first current result.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: With latest=true: the search location.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum monthly rent (USD).

parameters.name: bedrooms
parameters.description: Bedrooms, comma list of 0 (studio) to 5 (5 means 5+).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Rent research for a US or Canadian city: median and average rent, yearly and monthly changes, listing count, average size, rent ranges and monthly median history, by property type and by bedrooms; the same numbers for its neighborhoods, nearby cities and the whole country, plus Zumper's key takeaways.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zumper-neighborhoods

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A city ("Austin, TX"), a slug (austin-tx) or a zumper.com rent research link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Zumper's monthly rent report for a metro area: the introduction, the most and least expensive cities with their one-bedroom rents, the fastest growing and falling rents year over year and month over month, and the report's charts, with links to each city's report.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zumper-rent-report

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Metro city slug such as new-york-ny, san-francisco-ca or chicago-il (or a city name such as "Chicago, IL").

get.description:
Apartments, houses and rooms for rent in the US and Canada on Zumper, with the site's filters: place (city or neighborhood), rent range, bedrooms, bathrooms, size, property type, pets, building amenities, keywords and short-term rentals, plus sort. Each result has listing and building ids, link, title, property type, rent range, previous price, bedroom and bathroom ranges, floor plan count, availability date, listed date, address, neighborhood, coordinates, rating, pets, amenities, photos and the managing company or brokerage (name and phone; private landlords' names and phones are left out). `total` is the site's match count (capped at 9,000). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zumper-search

parameters.name: location

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum monthly rent (USD).

parameters.name: bedrooms

parameters.name: bathrooms_min
parameters.description: Minimum bathrooms.

parameters.name: area_min
parameters.description: Minimum size (sq ft).

parameters.name: area_max

parameters.name: limit

parameters.name: page

get.description:
The rentals Zumper recommends next to a listing or building, each with id, building, link, title, property type, price range, bedrooms, bathrooms, availability, address, neighborhood, coordinates, pets, amenities, photos and the professional manager.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zumper-similar

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A Zumper listing id, or a zumper.com listing or building link.

parameters.name: building_id
parameters.description: A building id (2007140) or the p-number in its link (p1503505) instead of id.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A zumper.com /listings/ or /apartment-buildings/ link instead of id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many (default 12, max 30).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
